facts.fact: British International Investment (BII, UK development finance institution) made a US$40M equity investment in IHS Zambia Limited, an independent telecoms tower operator with over 1,700 towers in Zambia, in October 2015; exited by March 2021.

British International Investment (BII, UK development finance institution) made a second US$25.5M equity investment in IHS Zambia Limited, a tower operator in Zambia, in July 2017; exited by March 2021.
